name: claude-managed-agents
notes: The closest brain anywhere: server-side append-only journal, mediated model calls, cron, REST and SSE. The loop is fixed and config-only.
No BYOK, so it cannot be pointed at the scripted provider. Every latency number here carries a real model and is excluded from engine comparisons by model_included.
Its real value in this set is the pricing row.

Measured with claude-haiku-4-5 to keep the run cheap; the model is named in the version because it changes the number. Every latency here contains real inference and a network round trip, so model_included is set on both probes and they are excluded from engine comparisons by design - this is the cost of a hosted agent, not a figure to put beside a kernel running against a fixture.

BLOCKED on credentials 2026-08-28: the driver is written and the API shapes are correct, but the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in .env.dev returns 401 authentication_error 'API key is invalid.' on POST /v1/agents. It is structurally a real key (sk-ant-api...) so it is stale or revoked rather than malformed. Supply a working key and this subject runs as-is.

create.definition: POST /v1/sessions against a stored agent until the response carries a session id; the container is provisioned behind it

round_trip.definition: user.message event submitted until the session returns to idle, one complete turn; Anthropic's model is inside this number and there is no way to point Managed Agents at a scripted provider
